switches.title: Switches Configuration
switches.description: Allows to configure multiple HomeKit switches to play notifications or tracks.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the switch to be added to HomeKit.

sonosDeviceNames.title: Sonos Device Names
sonosDeviceNames.description: The names of the Sonos devices this notification should be played on.

items.title: Device Name
items.description: Name of a Sonos device in your local network.

onlyWhenPlaying.title: Only When Playing
onlyWhenPlaying.description: Only play this notification, if the device is already playing.

tracks.title: Tracks Configuration
tracks.description: If multiple tracks are configured for a switch, a track will be selected at random.

trackUri.title: Track URI
trackUri.description: The URI of the notification to be played. Must be WAV or MP3 for native notifications. Otherwise any trackUri that is supported by Sonos can be configured.

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: Volume of the notification. If not specified, the current volume of the device is used.

nativeNotification.title: Native Notification
nativeNotification.description: Uses the native notification feature of Sonos. See restrictions with trackUris.

seekPosition.title: Seek Position
seekPosition.description: Jump to the given position in the track. Format: hh:mm:ss. Do not use for stream URIs.

stopAfter.title: Stop Playing After
stopAfter.description: Stop playing after the given amount of milliseconds.

repeatContinuously.title: Repeat Continuously
repeatContinuously.description: Repeats this track continuously using Sonos' 'repeat one' functionality.

cronExpressions.title: Cron Expressions
cronExpressions.description: Triggers this switch based on the given cron expressions.

sonosDeviceIp.title: Sonos Device IP
sonosDeviceIp.description: If auto discovery of Sonos devices fails in your local network, enter the IP of any S2 Sonos device. For this to work reliably, a static IP should be assigned to this device.

sonosS1DeviceIp.title: Sonos S1 Device IP
sonosS1DeviceIp.description: IP of a Sonos (legacy) S1 device. If set, a second discovery is performed to find all S1 devices. For this to work reliably, a static IP should be assigned to this device. Auto-discovery will only find S2 devices.
